preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line (the number of test cases T).

preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() in ('0', '1') for line in stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case line contains only binary characters '0' or '1'.
The number of test cases T matches the number of subsequent lines.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.
Each output line is a valid non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(lambda i: int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[i]) == min((len([j for j in range(len(s)-1) if s[j] != s[j+1]]) + 1) // 2 if s else 0) for i, s in enumerate(stdin.strip().splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: For each binary string S, the output is the minimum operations required, calculated as the number of groups of consecutive identical characters minus 1, divided by 2 (integer division), which corresponds to the optimal strategy of flipping the smaller set of alternating groups.
